train.via: Changsha South Station to Shaoshan South

trips.route_note: Take a high-speed train from Changsha South to Xiangtan North (about 30 minutes), then a bus or taxi to Shaoshan (about 1 hour); buses run regularly from the Xiangtan station area.
see: Mao Zedong's Former Residence area Jiangxi hilltop views
trips.why: The drive takes about 56 minutes door to door, while the train needs a change at Xiangtan North and about 1h51m in total.
know: Shaoshan is Mao Zedong's birthplace, so the sights are mainly historical and memorial sites.
Expect large crowds on weekends and national holidays, so go early on those days.
